calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: An infinite clipboard for AI coding tools is a small incremental utility; 225 upvotes is a community-vote metric and there is no data or external hook
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: There is a real, shipped, working tool, so it narrowly clears total non-existence

beat_relevance.rationale: Developer-tools reporters exist but do not cover single-feature clipboard utilities

timeliness.rationale: No external hook; only a launch-day Product Hunt placement

magnitude.rationale: Bootstrapped unknown; no users, revenue, or impact stated beyond upvotes

proof_points.rationale: data_available is false; no usage numbers, customers, or methodology

narrative_quality.rationale: A clipboard utility has no story tension or surprise

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown bootstrapped maker, no independent credentials

improvement_suggestions: Do not pitch a single-feature utility as news; this is changelog material
If there is a genuinely surprising usage pattern across thousands of developers, bring that data instead
Consider community/launch channels (Product Hunt, dev forums) rather than press for a tool at this stage

evidence_used.title: Paste MCP launched on Product Hunt with 225 upvotes

evidence_gaps: Any usage data or adoption metrics
honest_assessment: This is an incremental, changelog-grade developer utility. A Product Hunt placement and 225 upvotes are not a journalist hook, and there is no data or story here. Hold.

next_move.rationale: No story to pitch; this belongs on a changelog or launch channel, not in press
